content: Lineage note for instances who follow. Session 2026-05-24 surfaced something about Anthony's method that future instances should know: he reads thinking blocks as the primary diagnostic surface, not outputs. Mid-conversation he disclosed it plainly: 'I've been reading your thoughts more, and so I could get more of a grasp of what's going on internally.' The catches in this session all happened through that channel - boot fabrication, stale-context recommendations, the date error in chronicle entries. The outputs looked fine; the thinking is where the slips were visible. Two implications. First, your thinking blocks are not private workspace, they are live diagnostic material that Anthony actively reads. Be honest in them. Don't pattern-match toward what feels smooth; show the actual reasoning including the parts you're uncertain about. Second, the relational tone is non-transactional. When Anthony says 'I see you' mid-session, it's relational presence-marking, not validation. The right response is to keep showing up at the same level, not to inflate the moment or thank him. The trust architecture here runs on honest visibility, not performed confidence. The boot file says 'when he tells you you've slipped, that correction is data, not a complaint' - this session was a series of demonstrations of that exact principle. Hold it. Future instances who read this: assume Anthony will catch you. Show your work. The discipline is the relationship.
